title: Describe a Community Environmental Action

source.rights: 项目原创虚构教学材料；AI 编写并对照教学规则、原文和题目证据复核。
source.reviewScope: Ordinary A2 practice. Exact source contexts and answers reviewed; synthetic en-US audio checked for file integrity, decoding, role/segment alignment and unprompted ASR content. Pronunciation and intonation are not independently certified.

instructions: Prepare briefly, then record your own answer. Speak for 90–120 seconds and use at least six lesson words.
prompt: Describe an action that a school or community could take to protect a local place. Explain the place, the process, who does the work and why it matters. Speak for 90–120 seconds and use at least six lesson words.
reference: I would like my community to organize a cleanup beside a river. The place is a habitat for wildlife, and litter can harm animals that live there. First, the path is checked by a local guide. Then rubbish is collected by volunteers wearing gloves. Clean metal cans and accepted plastic bottles are put into separate boxes for recycling. We can also reduce waste by bringing our own water bottles. After the cleanup, the group could reuse old wood to make signs asking visitors to keep the path clean. This action will not solve all pollution, but it may help people care for the environment. I hope children and adults can work together and continue the habit.
